Asha (CS): Urgent - onboarding embedding indexing failing for a slice of VPC tenants after last night's DB migration. Need embargoed customer note + per-tenant ETA.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-458 created 1: bridge https://bridge.redwood.ai/INC-2026-458

Marcus (SRE): Root cause: migration changed indexer write timeout; batches aborted and entered retry loop. Reverted the change at 03:12 UTC and paused new starts. Requeue started.

Liam (Eng): Requeue in progress. ~75% auto-complete, ~25% need manual resume. Building bulk-resume tool, ETA ~2h. Will upload script + runbook to /shared/cs when ready.

Marcus (SRE): Uploaded per-tenant snapshot to /shared/cs/emb-index-affected.csv. Example ETAs: tenant-rose ~20m, tenant-aurora manual resume 40m, tenant-peak reprocess ~90m, tenant-cedar needs data scrub ~3-4h.

Asha (CS): Draft short customer message: 'We're investigating an issue with embedding indexing for some private/VPC customers after a DB migration. Engineering reverted the change and is reprocessing jobs. Most tenants will recover within 3 hours; your CS rep will follow up with a tenant-specific ETA and remediation options.' Thoughts?

Priya (SE): Add reassurance: 'No model weights or customer files were deleted or exposed; this is an indexing state/regeneration issue.' I can provide FR/DE translations and short DM variants.

Jorge (CS Manager): Approve. Offer: opt-in 1-week dedicated-capacity credit OR one-time $500 onboarding credit for heavily impacted customers. Schedule office hours tomorrow 9-11am PT. Flag renewal-risk accounts to GTM.

Asha (CS): Need a canned Zendesk reply to paste. Also will send priority outreach once CSV + ETA column attached in ~15m.

Marcus (SRE): Support template uploaded: /shared/cs/templates/emb-index-incident.txt. Diagnostic to share: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/<tenant>/indexing/status` returns state + last_error + job_id.

Liam (Eng): Confirm no model artifacts lost. Full RCA and timeline will follow after reprocessing completes.

Asha (CS): Sending emails now. Will post final sent copy and list of accounts reached here. Thanks all :heart:
